def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace / normalize label variants in text columns
    for col in ["island", "species", "sex"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype("string").str.strip()
    # fix misspelled species label
    df["species"] = df["species"].replace({"Adeile": "Adelie"})
    # normalize sex case
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].str.lower()
    # drop exact duplicate rows (penguin_id is a unique id)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.dropna(subset=["island"]).groupby("island").size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()
